mechanism.claim: An extreme completed endpoint displacement relative to its own realized quadratic variation is a statistically one-sided auction excursion. When this self-normalized displacement newly enters its upper magnitude tail during elevated absolute variation, fade the exhausted displacement for eight hours.
mechanism.side: negative strict sign of completed eight-hour displacement
mechanism.why_distinct: L1 path efficiency divides displacement by total absolute travel; bipower jump candidates compare one return with prior robust variation; skew and semivariance use signed moments. HVSNDR uses the block endpoint divided by the L2 norm of all completed five-minute close returns, and reuses no event set or control.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: offset three-daily onsets from a self-normalized endpoint excursion are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_window: 480 exact coherent bars_binance BTCUSDT interval=1m rows [D-8h,D)
features.aggregation: 96 exact five-minute groups with OHLC first/max/min/last
features.returns: 95 natural-log close-to-close returns from aggregated closes
features.displacement: log(last five-minute close/first five-minute open), finite strict nonzero
features.realized_variation: sum squared 95 close-to-close returns, finite strict positive
features.magnitude_rank: strict-prior midrank of absolute self-normalized displacement over at most 270 earlier source-valid blocks, minimum 180; current excluded; rank>=0.80
features.l1_efficiency_control: abs(displacement)/sum(abs(five-minute returns)), finite; strict-prior 270/180 rank>=0.80 diagnostic only
features.variation_rank: strict-prior 270/180 midrank of realized variation; current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.eligible_state: self-normalized magnitude and variation gates pass
features.onset: eligible now and immediately previous exact source-valid block ineligible

clock.decision: D after the full path completes
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal entry
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact realized funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no aggregation, normalization, rank, onset, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, or control repair
